title: a state in the one-turn shape never stops the runner
line: a state kept beside the database in the one-turn shape (one turn paused on its pages, its keys as the owner's own state file holds them) never makes the runner refuse: a run reads it as that person waiting on the pages the fetch list holds for them now, writes it back as an entry of the people who wait, the queue passes them over on those pages, and the run goes on to its turn; a state in that shape whose person has no page open is dropped, the run's report naming them as waiting no more
